name: corenet-proxy
description: A native Node.js Layer 7 reverse proxy and load balancer: TCP/TLS 1.3 termination, HTTP/2 multiplexing, DNS/SNI, and Round-Robin backend routing. Zero dependencies.

scripts.certs: openssl req -x509 -nodes -newkey rsa:2048 -sha256 -days 365 -keyout key.pem -out cert.pem -subj "/C=IN/ST=Tamil Nadu/L=Chennai/O=CoreNet Labs/OU=Edge Gateway/CN=corenet.local" -addext "subjectAltName=DNS:corenet.local,DNS:api.corenet.local,DNS:static.corenet.local,DNS:localhost,IP:127.0.0.1" -addext "basicConstraints=critical,CA:FALSE" -addext "keyUsage=critical,digitalSignature,keyEncipherment" -addext "extendedKeyUsage=serverAuth"
scripts.demo:mux: curl -sk --http2 --parallel -o /dev/null https://localhost:8443/api/s1?delay=1200 -o /dev/null https://localhost:8443/api/s2?delay=1200 -o /dev/null https://localhost:8443/api/s3?delay=1200 -o /dev/null https://localhost:8443/api/s4?delay=1200 -o /dev/null https://localhost:8443/api/s5?delay=1200
